levels.surface: محمد بن عبد الله بن يزيد
محمد بن عبد الله بن يزيد

notes: Two routes (through «مجاهد» and through «يزيد بن أبي زياد») each repeat the head; both end at Ibn Abi Layla as written

«وأبو فروة عن عبد الله بن عكيم، قال استسقى حذيفة» names a further route whose head is not written: left out as unresolved, so the Companion chain «عبد الله بن عكيم» and «حذيفة» is not attached to these groups; reviewer to check
The reading of the head depends on «ح»-free co-transmission: no name is supplied from memory
